content.text: The assignment provisions all favor us; no hidden Vendor exit right on our change of control.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full. 24.1 lets us assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (notice only, with assignee assumption). 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bars assignment to a direct competitor without our consent. 24.3 is a balanced residual consent provision with a reasonableness standard. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control, and requires cooperation with successor administrative changes. A document-wide search for "change of control" and "assign" surfaced no hidden Vendor exit or re-pricing trigger; §9.2 insolvency termination is mutual and expressly excludes lawful reorganization, and §13.3 permits transfer of licence rights consistent with Section 24. No redline required.
